gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4 prints columns General, Street, Park, Sales Tax (Special Revenue), Other Governmental Funds, Eliminations, Total. detail[] holds only the Other Governmental Funds column (via the nonmajor combining statement p10, total revenues 57,073). The four major columns have no schedule of their own: General total revenues 453,630 (Taxes 357,236 + Intergovernmental 39,649 + Interest 171 + Licenses and permits 4,940 + Miscellaneous 51,634), Street 221,277 (Intergovernmental 221,140 + Miscellaneous 137), Park 67,772 (Charges for services 59,005 + Interest 9 + Miscellaneous 8,758), Sales Tax 241,958 (Intergovernmental 241,322 + Interest 636). 453,630 + 221,277 + 67,772 + 241,958 = 984,637 = gap. Check: 57,073 + 984,637 = 1,041,710 = printed Total Governmental Funds total revenues (p4).

gaps.explanation: The report prints the proprietary operating statement twice with different figures. Basic statement p6 (used for the statement lines): Water Charges for service 320,725, Totals 579,152 + interest income 7,977 = 587,129. Supplementary statement p11 (report p37, used for detail): Water Charges for service 324,688, Totals 583,115 + interest income 7,977 = 591,092. Difference 324,688 - 320,725 = 3,963 = gap (-3,963). Both are printed figures (already in report_discrepancies); detail is as printed on p11, so no fix.

Same two printed versions. p6: Water Sales taxes 9,542, total operating expenses 529,666 + interest expense 11,592 = 541,258. p11: Water Sales taxes 9,930, total operating expenses 530,054 + interest expense 11,592 = 541,646. Difference 9,930 - 9,542 = 388 = gap (-388). Both printed; detail as printed on p11, so no fix.
